tooltip.empty: Drag widgets here to tuck them away
tooltip.autoHideOff: Stays open until you close it
tooltip.hoverMode: Opens while the pointer is over it
settings.title: Tuck
settings.autoHide.desc: Close again after a while. Waits while the pointer is over it or a tucked widget's panel is open.
settings.autoHide.hoverDesc: In hover mode it closes when the pointer leaves.
settings.startOpen.desc: Show tucked widgets when the shell starts.
settings.syncMonitors.desc: A click opens and closes the bar on all screens together. The hotkey always does.
settings.showCount.desc: Number of tucked widgets beside the arrow while closed.
settings.hideWhenEmpty.desc: No arrow while nothing is tucked. It comes back while you drag a widget.
settings.animate.desc: Slide open and closed. Off follows Omarchy's own animation switch too.
settings.noneTucked: Nothing tucked yet. Drag a widget along the bar and drop it beside the arrow.
settings.hotkey: Hotkey: bind omarchy-shell tim.tuck toggle · settings: omarchy-shell tim.tuck openSettings
tooltip.trayConflict: Omarchy's tray is also on the bar: remove one of the two
settings.trayConflict: Omarchy's tray is also on your bar, and both show the same widgets. Drag one of them off the bar.
